name: Bulb Bowl
dimensions: Diameter: 23.5 cm (9 1/4 in.); Overall: 8 cm (3 1/8 in.)
summary: Numbered Jun ware is inscribed with a number on its bottom—in this case number "two"—and is thought to have been made initially for the early Ming imperial court. The number indicates size, with "one" being the largest and "ten" being the smallest. Another characteristic is the "earthworm trail" lef
